name: Naka no Hito nado Inai! Tokyo Hero Project
original_name: 中の人などいない！ トーキョー・ヒーロー・プロジェクト
source:
The Tokyo Hero Project was a plan which was implemented two years ago, placing cosplaying heroes in each of the 23 wards to promote public order. But not many people knew that they actually possessed special powers and fought against the secret evil society Black Outsiders (BO) at night. 

Koutarou is a poor student who lives by himself. One night while he was making his way to a part-time job, he saw a fierce battle between a cosplayer and someone wearing a [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kigurumi]kigurumi[/url]. Due to the incident, he ended up missing his part-time opportunity and his friend Nagahiko suggested a new one for him. A young girl with a black manteau welcomed him: “How wonderful it is to have you here at the secret society BO group!”. From that day on, he battles against heroes while wearing a mascot character powered suit. Do your best, Koutarou!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/august-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
東京英雄計畫是兩年前實施的一項計畫，在23個區各部署一名角色扮演英雄以維護治安。但很少有人知道，他們實際上擁有特殊能力，並在夜間與秘密邪惡組織「黑色局外人」（BO）戰鬥。

幸太郎是一名獨自生活的窮學生。一天晚上，他在去打工的路上，目睹了一名cosplayer和一個穿著[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kigurumi]布偶裝[/url]的人之間的激烈戰鬥。由於這場騷動，他錯過了打工機會，好友長彥為他介紹了一份新的工作。一個身穿黑色斗篷的小女孩迎接了他：「歡迎來到秘密結社BO！」從那天起，他穿上吉祥物動力裝甲，與英雄們展開戰鬥。加油啊，幸太郎！

［來自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/august-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
